intro: Frostsaber Rock is a towering stone promontory rising above the snowy northern reaches of Winterspring. It serves as the primary sanctuary and training grounds for the noble frostsaber cats of the region.

p: Rising high above the frozen wastes of northern Winterspring, Frostsaber Rock commands a sweeping view of the snowbound wild. The crag is named for the fierce, majestic frostsaber predators that prowl the slopes and valleys below. At its highest apex resides Rivern Frostwind, a solitary night elf dedicated to raising and tending these beasts. For champions loyal to the Alliance willing to brave the harsh conditions and prove their devotion, Rivern offers the rare privilege of learning to raise, tame, and ride one of these legendary snowy mounts.
